# AMD ROCm Cloud Platform and Remote Development

This chapter is used to select the operating platform, confirm the persistence directory, and establish remote development access. Basic operations for web buttons, JupyterHub, and Code Server are provided in the [ platform manipulation appendix ](appendices/AUP_JUPYTER_CODE_SERVER.md).

## Platform Selection

| Platform | Suitable Tasks | Storage and Network | Usage Recommendations |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| AUP Learning Cloud | Download public data, install dependencies, Notebook learning, training, and evaluation | Accessible via GitHub and Hugging Face; follow the persistent directories shown on the platform | Priority entry for this topic |
| AMD Developer Cloud | ROCm template pre-check, GPU training, and performance testing | Only the PVC of `/workspace` is retained after instance restart; other directories are treated as temporary space | Place source code, models, and results in `/workspace` |
| Local AMD workstation | Long-term training, batch evaluation, and video generation | Plan data disk and cache by yourself | Suitable for continuous experiments |

The quota, GPU model, and instance lifecycle may be adjusted. Please refer to the current information on the platform page.

## First Inspection

Run after entering the terminal:

```bash
id
pwd
df -h
python --version
which python
```

Then confirm the AMD GPU and ROCm:

```bash
rocminfo | sed -n '1,80p'
python - <<'PY'
import torch

print("torch:", torch.__version__)
print("hip:", torch.version.hip)
print("available:", torch.cuda.is_available())
print("device:", torch.cuda.get_device_name(0) if torch.cuda.is_available() else None)
assert torch.cuda.is_available()
assert torch.version.hip is not None
PY
```

PyTorch on ROCm uses the `torch.cuda` interface, so the device string is still written as `cuda`. `torch.version.hip` is used to confirm that the current installation comes from a ROCm build.

## Persistent Directory

It is recommended to use `WORK_ROOT` to manage large files uniformly:

```bash
export WORK_ROOT=${WORK_ROOT:-$HOME/physical-ai}

# AMD 开发者云使用持久化 PVC：
# export WORK_ROOT=/workspace/physical-ai

# AUP 镜像若约定 /home/jovyan 持久化：
# export WORK_ROOT=/home/jovyan/physical-ai

export SRC_ROOT=$WORK_ROOT/src
export DATA_ROOT=$WORK_ROOT/datasets
export MODEL_ROOT=$WORK_ROOT/checkpoints
export RUN_ROOT=$WORK_ROOT/runs
export CACHE_ROOT=$WORK_ROOT/cache
export HF_HOME=$CACHE_ROOT/huggingface
export PIP_CACHE_DIR=$CACHE_ROOT/pip
export UV_CACHE_DIR=$CACHE_ROOT/uv

mkdir -p "$SRC_ROOT" "$DATA_ROOT" "$MODEL_ROOT" "$RUN_ROOT" \
  "$HF_HOME" "$PIP_CACHE_DIR" "$UV_CACHE_DIR"
```

Before restarting the instance, copy the model, data, and results to a persistent directory. The temporary virtual environment can be recreated without occupying space in the Git repository.

## Source Code and Model Download

```bash
cd "$SRC_ROOT"
git clone https://github.com/datawhalechina/every-embodied.git
cd every-embodied

hf auth login
hf auth whoami
```

Before downloading the restricted model, complete the access application on the Hugging Face website. The login credentials are stored in the user configuration directory and are not written to the Notebook, script, or repository.

## SSH Service

Some images do not have the SSH service pre-installed. You can execute it with administrator privileges:

```bash
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install -y openssh-server iproute2
sudo mkdir -p /run/sshd
sudo ssh-keygen -A
sudo service ssh restart
ss -lntp | grep ':22'
```

If the platform uses port mapping, it shall follow the host and port shown on the page:

```bash
ssh -p <PORT> <USER>@<HOST>
```

The SSH connection is only responsible for the remote terminal. The startup, shutdown, and termination of instances are still performed through the platform console.

## Running Special Topic

```bash
cd "$SRC_ROOT/every-embodied/16-专题组队学习/04-AMD-ROCm策略复刻专题"
jupyter lab --ip=0.0.0.0 --no-browser
```

First, run the [ device and environment to confirm ](01-amd-rocm-device-and-environment-confirmation.md), then press [ to download the baseline data and model from the unified directory ](10-simulation-benchmark-download-and-unified-directory.md).

## Platform Switch

During the recovery experiment on another device, simply reset the directory variable and confirm the four types of materials:

1. Source code repository and upstream version;
2. Dataset directory and metadata;
3. Model directory and training configuration;
4. Evaluation results, videos, and running configuration.

The training script and Notebook use `$SRC_ROOT`, `$DATA_ROOT`, `$MODEL_ROOT`, and `$RUN_ROOT`, and avoid binding the absolute path of a specific server.
